job.title: Assembly Technician
job.description:
Join a skilled production team manufacturing high-quality specialist machinery for customers throughout New Zealand and international markets.
 
This is a truly unique position where you will be assembling specialist machines with a range of different customised options. This is clean assembly work utilising a variety of componentry on new machinery that are renowned for their high level of reliability so requires a methodical thorough approach with an eye for detail.  
 
Previous experience assembling technical equipment is ideal coupled with the ability to ensure correct processes are always followed in a timely manner.  
 
Tasks include:
  • All aspects of assembly of the chassis including installation and assembling of various mechanical systems.
  • Interpret and use of schematics, process procedures, and other written documentation to complete the assembly of components.
  • Confident to operate machinery and carry out testing of assembled equipment.
  • Meet documented specification requirements and quality control standards in a cost effective and timely manner.
  • Maintain a neat, clean, and organised work area.
  • Complete paperwork accurately and in a timely manner as required by the manufacturing process.
  • Follow all applicable safety policies, precautions, recommendations and procedures.
Must Demonstrate the following:
  • Have a mechanical aptitude with practical, hands-on experience
  • Some basic experience with hydraulic and electrical systems
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to understand and follow processes
  • Pride in producing quality results
  • Good attention to detail, thoroughness, and accuracy
  • A proven team player who can work autonomously
 If you're looking for a hands-on role where quality workmanship is valued and you can contribute to building world-class equipment, we'd like to hear from you.
 
All applicants must have NZ residency or a valid work visa to be considered for this role. Our client is not an accredited employer and therefore cannot offer sponsorship.

job.title: Export Dispatch Assistant - Fixed term
job.description:
We're seeking an Export Dispatch Assistant to join a busy Hawke's Bay export operation for the 2026/27 season. Working closely with the Export Dispatch Supervisor and wider packhouse team, you'll play a key role in coordinating export orders, dispatches and documentation to ensure premium produce reaches customers around the world on time.
 
About the Role
You will be responsible for supporting the smooth and accurate dispatch of export shipments, ensuring customer orders, container loading schedules and export documentation are completed correctly and on time.
 
Key duties include:
  • Assisting with export order coordination and dispatch schedules
  • Checking product specifications, quantities and shipment requirements
  • Completing dispatch, traceability and export documentation
  • Recording and uploading information into company systems
  • Liaising with transport providers and logistics contacts
  • Monitoring shipment deadlines and escalating any issues
  • Working closely with forklift operators and packhouse staff
  • Supporting general operational requirements throughout the season
What We're Looking For
Success in this role will come down to your attention to detail, ability to follow processes and practical judgement.

You'll ideally have:
  • Strong computer skills and confidence learning new systems
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to work with numbers, data entry and documentation
  • Strong organisational skills and ability to meet deadlines
  • A calm, methodical approach under pressure
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills
  • Reliability, flexibility and a strong work ethic
  • Previous experience in dispatch, logistics, warehousing, administration or export operations (preferred but not essential)
Hours of Work
This is a seasonal role supporting export operations and shipping schedules.
 
Typical hours are:
  • Monday to Saturday
  • Approximately 6:00am/7:00am to 5:00pm
  • Occasional Sunday work during peak periods
  • Some flexibility with occasional mid-weekdays off depending on shipping requirements
 Apply Now
If you're highly organised, enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and want to be part of a successful Hawke's Bay export operation, we'd love to hear from you.
 
Apply today through EQUIP People and secure your place for the upcoming export season.
